Package domain

Class RegisteredUser

java.lang.Object
domain.User
domain.RegisteredUser
public class RegisteredUser extends User
Author:
Joel Forcadell (joel.forcadell@estudiantat.upc.edu) Represents a registered user in the system. Stores the user's ID, username, password, and email address. Provides validation for username, password, and email format.
